hero.subtitle: WHMSYCODE is a one-person studio building simple, useful apps for iOS and Android. No bloat, no dark patterns — just tools that do one thing well.

whyUs.title: Privacy by default
whyUs.description: No tracking, no ad networks, no data you didn't ask to share. What happens on your device stays on your device.

whyUs.title: Made with care
whyUs.description: Every app is built and maintained by one person, not a growth team — small enough to actually get better over time.

whyUs.title: No bloat, ever
whyUs.description: No subscriptions you forgot about, no dark patterns nudging you into upsells. Just tools that do one thing well.
